scenes.say: Journey seven: book a meeting. A member requests a meeting time for a service with a business. This run takes the journey from ninety-five percent to complete.
Until now, every business met at the same five fixed times. Now the owner decides. Naomi owns Luzandre.com, and My services has a new button: Meeting hours.
The dialog shows the hours in force: the days of the week, from and until as Toronto times, and how often a time is offered. Requests she already has keep their times.
Naomi meets on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday, so she unticks the other days and ticks Saturday.
She sets from to ten, and by mistake until to nine. Save hours saves nothing, and the field says: choose a time after ten a.m.
She corrects it to noon and saves. The dialog closes, and My services says: meeting hours saved.
Now a member. Joanna books a meeting with Legacy Financial, a business that saved those same hours. She picks a Thursday and is offered four times: every thirty minutes from ten, each ending by noon.
A sixty-minute review must end by noon as well, so eleven thirty is no longer offered.
A Friday is not one of the days. The dialog says Trevor can't meet on that day, and names the days he does.
Joanna goes back to Thursday, chooses ten thirty and sends the request. Nothing is charged. Trevor confirms it or declines.

Behind the screen, the API decides, and checks again whatever the dialog checked. The hours are Toronto times of day on either side of a clock change, only the owner sets them, and requests already sent keep their day, time and status. Nineteen API test cases prove it.

Two criteria that had no test now have one. In the browser, the note of a booking stops at one thousand characters. In the API, the owner gets an in-app notification of the booking, and the member one when it is confirmed.

Requirement two hundred and twenty and decision record forty-seven hold this work, and journey seven is complete. Left for the owner: the visual, responsive and accessibility sweeps. Different hours on different days, calendars and double booking are not built.
